seed_standard: United Nations Statistics Division M49 countries or areas
mission: Discover and maintain a source-grounded government map for every jurisdiction in scope, then enumerate departments/agencies, government levels, jobs, services, forms, fees, fiscal sources, procurement, grants and public data one jurisdiction at a time.
department_iteration_rule: For each discovered department, generate independent service, job/task, spending, procurement, data/API, accessibility and productivity benchmark cases and route every gap to parallel builders.
local_government_rule: National jurisdiction discovery must also identify the authoritative directory or registry used to enumerate states/provinces/regions and local governments; do not assume every country uses U.S.-style state/county/city structures.
freshness_rule: Department existence, names, programs, fees, links and authorities can change; each record requires last_verified and source provenance.
truth_rule: A jurisdiction or department is not considered mapped because a search result exists. DreamCo requires an authoritative government source or a clearly marked unresolved discovery state.
